correctness.rationale: Both 16-vertex 6-regular strongly regular graphs have α=4 via Hoffman eigenvalue −2 and explicit witnesses. Every rook 4-set is one permutation graph, yielding 24 states; intersection in two positions corresponds exactly to a transposition, giving Cay(S4, six transpositions), 72 edges, degree6, radius/diameter3. In Shrikhande, exhaustive 84 triple check for zero-containing 4-cocliques gives four order-four subgroup classes, three cyclic and H0=2Z4². Four H0 cosets are six-valent hubs; twelve cyclic cosets each meet two hubs in 2 vertices, with two distinct cyclic cosets for every pair of hubs, giving doubled subdivision of K4, 24 edges, degree multiset 6^4 2^12, radius3, diameter4. No two optimal sets intersect in exactly three vertices, so X1 is edgeless in both and minimum connected exchange budget is two. Independent exhaustive enumeration checked all 16 choose 4 and choose 5 subsets, constructed graphs and all-pairs distances: Shrikhande 16 states/24 edges/radius3/diameter4; rook 24/72/3/3. Finite exhaustiveness IS complete for these two explicitly finite graphs.
